name: Réparateur des harnais
description: Muscular adult with thick legs and strong hands, charcoal skin with orange mottling, flat wide forehead, black dreads separated into four tied bundles, unmasked broad mandibles. Tan sleeveless travel jacket over netting, brown leather apron panel, bronze calf guards. Holds a leather cargo strap assembly with a large bronze buckle and a short stitching awl safely downward; spare straps bundled against pack. Casual slight elbow bend.
